body.name: Certificate-based exact all-order recovery
body.construction: \(\mathsf{FiberCert}(R,d)\) enumerates every \(\pi\in\mathfrak S_V\), forms \(B^{\pi}(R_0)\), \(v^{\pi}(R_0)\), and \(\Omega_e^{\pi}(R_0;d)\), and retains \(\operatorname{supp}(B^{\pi}(R_0))\) precisely when \(\Omega_{e,ii}^{\pi}(R_0;d)>0\) for every \(e\in\mathcal E\) and \(i\in V\), and, for every \(e\in\mathcal E\) and \(i<j\), \((\Omega_{e,ij}^{\pi}(R_0;d))^2=R_{e,ij}^2\Omega_{e,ii}^{\pi}(R_0;d)\Omega_{e,jj}^{\pi}(R_0;d)\) and \(\Omega_{e,ij}^{\pi}(R_0;d)R_{e,ij}\ge0\). It deduplicates the retained labeled supports with a binary-support trie.
